Topic 5.2: Church as a By the end of the Sub strand

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Church as a By the end of the Sub strand. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is prayer?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate prayer as a way of communicating with God

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. appreciate prayer as a way of communicating with God
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate prayer as a way of communicating with God. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Church as a By the end of the Sub strand.
2. Explain Church as a By the end of the Sub strand to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: You should read Mathew 21:13 1. What is prayer? Church house of Prayer should be able to:
4. Show that you can: appreciate prayer as a way of communicating with God
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Church as a By the end of the Sub strand. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: What is prayer?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
